strings.\n打 ✗ 的目录里没有该有的文件，检查一下是不是选到了上一级。: Folders marked ✗ don't contain the expected files — did you pick the parent folder?
strings.○ 没装（名字会显示成 id，其他照常）: ○ Not installed (names show as IDs, everything else works)
strings.○ 还没填 —— 启动后按 F8，在「③ 覆盖窗」下面填: ○ Empty — press F8 after starting and fill it under ③ Overlay
strings.○ 还没有 —— 第一次启动会自动生成（约十几秒）: ○ Not built yet — created on first start (~15 s)
strings.⚠ config.json 解析失败（可能手改坏了），现在按空配置显示；保存时会: ⚠ config.json could not be parsed (probably hand-edited); showing defaults. A backup will be saved to config.json.bak
strings.⚠ config.json 解析失败，按空配置显示；保存时会先备份: ⚠ config.json could not be parsed; showing defaults. A backup will be made before saving
strings.三段提示词：世界观与文风进 system，角色状态进 user。改完点保存，1–: Three prompts: world & style go into system, party state into user. Save applies in 1–2 s.
strings.世界观补充：优先级最高。写 mod 角色的来历、人物之间的关系、哪些名字容易被误: World notes: highest priority. Origins of mod characters, relationships, names that are easy to confuse.
strings.主程序退出了（代码 %s，运行 %d 秒）。点「导出日志」把 out\\ 一起发: The main program exited (code %s, ran %d s). Use Export logs and send the out\ folder.
strings.事实清单不给你的东西，写进这里也没用；这里只管「怎么写」，不管「发生了什么」。: Nothing written here can add facts the list doesn't contain; this only controls how it is written.
strings.优先级最高。写角色来历、人物关系、哪些名字容易被误解。留空 = 只用游戏事实；模: Highest priority. Character origins, relationships, names that are easy to confuse. Empty = game facts only; edit the template freely.
strings.你是《暗黑地牢》的旁白。写这一小段现场，3–6句，只写事实清单里的名字。: You are the narrator of Darkest Dungeon. Write this short scene in 3–6 sentences, using only names from the fact list.
strings.你要的文风与规矩都写在这里。留空 = 使用内置。保存后 1–2 秒内生效。: Your style and rules go here. Empty = built-in. Takes effect 1–2 s after saving.
strings.关掉后只发事实卡: When off, only fact cards are sent
strings.内容点下面「世界观」写；这里只开关: Content is written under World; this is the switch
strings.写「事实」比写「形容词」有用；这里的名字必须和日志里出现的一致。Ctrl+S 保: Facts beat adjectives; names here must match the log. Ctrl+S to save.
strings.写盘校验失败：%s 没写进去: Write verification failed: %s was not written
strings.准备就绪。点「开始旁白」→ 悬浮窗出现 → 进游戏。: Ready. Click Start — the overlay appears, then launch the game.
strings.只管「怎么写」，不管「发生了什么」。写场景、句式、语域与硬约束。留空 = 用内置: Only how to write, never what happened. Scene, sentence rhythm, register, hard rules. Empty = built-in.
strings.只给名字；+15精准这类数值不发（会写成战报）: Names only; numeric bonuses are omitted
strings.启动后窗口会收起；再双击 exe 可停止。游戏请用窗口化 / 无边框全屏，运行中: The window hides after start; double-click the exe again to stop. Use Windowed or Borderless fullscreen; F8 for settings.

strings.御影先动。刀尖在石壁上划出两道白痕，第三下才咬进骨缝。\n碎屑落下来的时候，那具:

As the grit falls, the skeletal clerk still holds its arm raised.
strings.折叠=只看输出；「展开」看完整内容，框内可滚动、可选中复制、可右键复制全部: Collapsed = output only; Expand shows the full text — scroll, select, right-click to copy all
strings.接口通了但正文为空——多半是推理型模型（如 *-reasoner/flash），: The API responded but the body was empty — likely a reasoning model (e.g. *-reasoner/flash). Use deepseek-chat or similar.
strings.改名字：填 id（上面的方括号里那个）+ 想显示的名字: Rename: enter the id (in brackets above) and the name to show
strings.改完点「保存并生效」，1–2 秒后主程序自动重载: Click Save & apply when done; the main program reloads in 1–2 s
strings.旁白还在运行。\n\n「是」= 停止并退出\n「否」= 让它继续跑，只关这个窗口:
The narration is still running.

Yes = stop and quit
No = keep it running, close this window
Cancel = do nothing

strings.没找到 Python 3（需要 3.9+，装的时候勾选 Add Python t: Python 3 not found (3.9+ required — tick "Add Python to PATH" when installing). Click Rescan afterwards.

strings.由已安装 mod 的本地化生成 · ★ 表示被 mod 覆盖过的译名: Generated from installed mods · ★ marks names overridden by a mod
strings.角色状态里 {{同伴}} / {{背景}} / {{变化}} 是数据插入点；删掉: {{party}} / {{background}} / {{changes}} are data slots; remove one and that block is not sent.
strings.记录会出现在这里：跑一段旁白，再按 F8 →「调试记录」刷新。: Records appear here: play a while, then press F8 → Debug log and refresh.
strings.跟着每一场的事实一起发。标题、说明文字、结尾那句都归这里；{{同伴}} 是队伍档: Sent along with each scene's facts. Title, captions and the closing line live here; {{party}} is the party dossier, {{background}} is status notes, {{changes}} is what changed this run.
